title: Mock notice proposes controls on selected semiconductor components
snippet: FICTIONAL MOCK NOTICE: A proposed export-control rule may affect selected semiconductor components. The notice states an effective date of November 15, 2026, while an attached transition section refers to December 1, 2026.

title: Mock agencies clarify semiconductor export-control transition
source: Mock Bureau of Industry and Security
snippet: FICTIONAL MOCK UPDATE: Agencies have not resolved whether the new controls begin November 15 or December 1. Companies should review component classifications and await final guidance.
